title: Anomaly.Session.Reset
description: Scoped reset (A.1). scope all: drop everything (static monster cache and item cards included). package: that package only (Anomaly.Items.Detail: drop the cached cards, sent when the game data reloads). room: room-bound state only (Room, Mob live state, Shop); sent to a subscriber of any room-bound module; the static monster cache survives (A.9). room names the NEW room.
